people.text: Nessa likes finding out about rare animals people don't often see, and she'd love the chance to watch some of them online. She'd like to play fun games too.

Bradley wants to know about different projects to help animals worldwide. He's hoping to find out about how to support animals where he lives, and to understand how nature programmes film the animals they follow.
Sofia wants to read about animals that help humans. She'd also love to learn about a job where people protect different species and is interested in organising a nature club in her area.
Ishaan wants to know what animals he can see in his garden. He also needs information for a school project about how animals survive in difficult conditions and would like some photos to include.

Fatima hopes to learn about how climate change affects wildlife, and what happened to animals that no longer exist. She also thinks communicating with other young nature - lovers around the world would be good.

items.label: A
items.title: Shared Planet
items.text: Follow the daily life of a researcher with interactive games – make decisions that save elephants and tigers! Although it's fun, there's a serious side – you'll discover important work experts do in real life. There's advice about setting up a local wildlife group, and articles with true stories about people being rescued by dolphins!

items.label: B
items.title: Discovery Zone
items.text: Animals survive in nearly every area of our planet. Find out about those living in the highest mountains, the hottest deserts and the coldest oceans. You can watch videos sent in by young people, showing animals they have filmed out and about in local parks – you're sure to see something new!

items.label: C
items.title: All About Animals
items.text: Our site's perfect for nature - lovers. Read an article about how a professional cameraman records videos of unusual animals, and see updates from international organisations on work to save creatures in danger. Feel inspired? Get ideas for things you can do, from making animal feeders for your garden to noting insect numbers.

items.label: D
items.title: Animal Centre
items.text: Learn how global warming is leading to decreasing numbers in some species and see pictures from this year's Nature Photography competition. As well as working dogs that help farmers find lost sheep, there's a film of the competition winner taking pictures of whales in Antarctica's icy seas.

items.label: E
items.title: World of Wildlife
items.text: Learn about wildlife you won't find in your back garden and find sections on species which are not very common, including those in danger of disappearing. With links to live cameras, you could spot some for yourself! Report what you've seen to directly help scientists with their work. With exciting puzzles and quizzes, there's lots to enjoy.

items.label: F
items.title: Amazing Animals
items.text: Discover incredible wildlife by reading reports from international scientists working in the Arctic. Together with pictures to download and film clips to watch, you'll learn what makes it possible for creatures to live in such a challenging location. But you'll find there's plenty to see closer to home, with tips on identifying wildlife where you live.

items.label: G
items.title: Incredible Nature
items.text: From huge dinosaurs to tiny insects, our planet is home to incredible animals. You'll learn how researchers are discovering new species, and what they do to make sure they are protected. You can follow links to documentaries and programmes about various animals – a great source of information.

items.label: H
items.title: Wildfacts
items.text: Millions of years ago, huge numbers of species disappeared from the planet. Find out why and discover the effect that rising temperatures are having on animals. There's a chat room, so you can enjoy sharing ideas with young people of all nationalities.

explanations.6: Nessa 喜欢了解罕见动物，希望能在线观看，还想玩有趣游戏。E 选项 “World of Wildlife” 有稀有和濒危物种专区，链接实时摄像头可自行观察，还有谜题和测验，符合需求。原文 “sections on species not very common... links to live cameras... exciting puzzles and quizzes” 对应 “rare animals, watch online, fun games”。
explanations.7: Bradley 想了解全球动物保护项目，支持本地动物，理解自然节目拍摄方式。C 选项 “All About Animals” 有国际组织拯救濒危生物的最新动态，教用家庭食材制作动物喂食器，还有专业摄影师记录不寻常动物的文章，符合需求。原文 “updates from international organisations... ideas for making animal feeders... article about professional cameraman” 对应 “protection projects, support local animals, filming methods”。
explanations.8: Sofia 想读帮助人类的动物故事，了解保护物种的工作，组织本地自然俱乐部。A 选项 “Shared Planet” 有海豚救人的真实故事，提供建立本地野生动物团体的建议，还有互动游戏让用户决策拯救大象和老虎，符合需求。原文 “true stories about people rescued by dolphins... advice about setting up a local wildlife group... interactive games to save elephants and tigers” 对应 “animals help humans, protect species job, organise nature club”。
explanations.9: Ishaan 想知道花园能看到什么动物，为学校项目找动物在困难条件下生存的信息和照片。F 选项 “Amazing Animals” 有北极科学家报告，教识别本地野生动物，提供下载图片和视频，解释动物在极端环境生存的原因，符合需求。原文 “tips on identifying wildlife where you live... pictures to download... learn what makes creatures live in challenging locations” 对应 “garden animals, survive in difficult conditions, photos”。
explanations.10: Fatima 想了解气候变化对野生动物的影响、已灭绝动物，与全球年轻自然爱好者交流。H 选项 “Wildfacts” 解释物种灭绝原因和气温上升对动物的影响，有聊天室可与各国年轻人分享想法，符合需求。原文 “find out why huge numbers of species disappeared... effect of rising temperatures... chat room to share ideas with young people of all nationalities” 对应 “climate change effect, extinct animals, communicate with others”。
